articles.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
articles.snippet: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

articles.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
articles.snippet: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.

articles.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
articles.snippet: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.

articles.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
articles.snippet: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.
